from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitData(BaseModel):
    """One company's 2024 Q1 after-deducting net profit from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/corporate registration code if available")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益后的净利润 for the quarter")
    unit: str = Field(default="元", description="Currency unit of the amount")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    profit_category: str | None = Field(description="Profit tier based on amount", 
                                          examples=["高利润", "中利润", "低利润", "负利润"])

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_data: list[CompanyProfitData]
